bio: Macdonald Bear Hotel is one of the finest 4-star hotels in Oxfordshire and offers a beautiful slice of luxury in the heart of the English countryside. Set in Woodstock, in what was once a 13th century coaching inn, the hotel combines history and culture with exceptional facilities. With direct access to the historic city of Oxford and being set on the ground of the Historic Blenheim Palace, this hotel is a popular choice for leisure breaks, business and weddings.  Afternoon Tea is served in MacDonald Bear Hotel's swish Churchill Bar, where you can enjoy views of the market square, or their two AA rosette-winning Restaurant.  Afternoon Tea is a quaint affair at the hotel, served on a three-tier stand laden with traditional treats such as elegant finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with thick Devonshire clotted cream and an array of decadent pastries. The best way to enjoy this enduring culinary tradition is with a classic tea or tisane - or if you really fancy a treat, with a glass of Champagne.  MacDonald Bear Hotel is a historic country house hotel, with the site dating back to the 13th century as a coaching inn. The hotel is directly accessible from Oxford and ideal location for a relaxing Afternoon Tea.
